Maya L.: Quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A on GTM and partnerships. Summarizing and asking for clarifications so ops/sales can act.
Jon Patel: Thanks Maya. Quick bullets: 1) Renewal prioritization: focus on contracts renewing in the next 90 days with >$25k ARR and any exec-level risk flags. 2) Partner-led vs self-serve: partner-led for strategic ISV/referral partners; continue bottoms-up for trial-to-paid motions. 3) Co-sell model tweaks: AEs keep primary ownership but partners get enablement hours + referral attribution.
Maya L.: For (1) can ops confirm which CRM view to use and whether to include product health signals?
Lena Ortiz: Use the CRM: "renewals_q3" saved view + product health tag "usage_drop" and "billing_alert". Ops-bot will post a nightly export to the ops drive.
Jon Patel: On partner-led measurement: marketing wants an "influenced pipeline" number, sales needs "attributed wins" for commission. We'll report both.
Maya L.: Any changes to routing if a partner-led opp grows past enterprise threshold?
Lena Ortiz: Short answer: keep partner-managed for the pilot phase (Q3). We'll evaluate handoffs in Oct. If there's an overlap with a named AE, we'll coordinate a joint ownership plan.
Maya L.: Action items: ops -> schedule nightly renewals export and share template (due Mon EOD). Partnerships -> publish co-sell enablement hours and referral attribution doc (due next Wed). Sales -> tag #partners early on partner-introduced opps.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Share renewals export and template by Mon 09:00 PT.
Jon Patel: I'll surface these in the leadership digest. Thanks everyone.
Maya L.: Appreciate the quick responses. If no objections I'll close the loop and send the summary to leadership later today.
